TIDE TABLE — Your trip checklist

Coastal walks: Rock Shelf Walk
Group size (including you): 8
Round trip: 1.2 km
Walking time: 60 min
Terrain: Uneven shelf, low ledges
Essential gear: Closed-toe grippy shoes, Drinking water, Light rain jacket
Extra gear: Field notebook, Dry bag

Illustrative walk. Check official tide times and local site access before leaving.
